sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) AS actual_sales_revenue,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS budget_sales_revenue,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS variance_amount,
    (sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2)) * 100.0
        / nullIf(sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2), 0) AS variance_pct
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS sp
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON sp.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE sp.AccountKey = 50
  AND toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009
  AND sp.ScenarioKey IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName
